title: 天天 – Episode 5: One long, slow conversation

Lin.style: a warm Chinese teacher chatting with a beginner over coffee, in standard Mandarin, slowly and clearly, with a small pause after each sentence, every tone exact, friendly and never rushed

Erik.style: a beginner speaking Mandarin slowly and carefully, every tone as written, relaxed and good-humoured

lines.text: 你好！ Welcome to 天天. I'm Lin.
lines.style: natural, relaxed English, as on a friendly podcast; any Chinese word in it said slowly and clearly, every tone exact

lines.text: And I'm Erik. 你好！ Lin, today is a bit different, isn't it?

lines.text: It is. Today there's no lesson. Just the two of us, talking. A long conversation, almost all in Chinese, and slowly, so you can follow every word.
lines.style: natural, relaxed English, as on a friendly podcast; any Chinese word in it said slowly and clearly, every tone exact

lines.text: All in Chinese. For a long time. Okay. And what happens when I don't understand something?

lines.text: Then you stop me and ask. And you ask in Chinese. Do you know how?

lines.text: Hmm. Something with 什么?

lines.text: Almost. You say the word, and then 是什么意思? 意思 is meaning. 什么意思, what meaning. So: 周末是什么意思? What does 周末 mean?

lines.text: 是什么意思. 周末是什么意思. Got it.

lines.text: And then I explain, and from then on we use the word. That's the whole game. Most of the words you know already from Tian. About ten will be new, and you'll hear each one many times.

lines.text: And if you speak too fast?
